title: Zesty Salted German Red Onion Bake
description: A light and herbal German dish featuring red onions, perfect for a low-calorie hangover cure. This recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together salt, black pepper, caraway seeds, garlic powder, and dried thyme.
Add the sliced red onions to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice and olive oil.
Pour the lemon juice mixture over the onions and toss to coat.
Transfer the onion mixture to a baking dish and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the onions are tender and lightly caramelized.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Zesty Salted German Red Onion Bake warm or at room temperature.
